label: input v at original positions 3-6 in sequences starting with 0/y/b
explanation: Very sparse reset-gate unit (0.03% of steps), fires only in the original-input phase, never on the delimiter or copy steps. About 91% of activation mass is on input token v at original positions 3-6 (peak at position 4). Firing is strongly modulated by the first original token: sequences starting with 0 (14x lift), y (6x) or b (3x) carry most mass, and the top examples are almost all 0-initial sequences with v at position 3-5. Only about 3% of v-at-position>=3 steps fire, and the prefix condition raises precision to about 25%. Which other earlier tokens determine whether it crosses threshold is not captured; consonants such as s, j, w, k, z, t, n appear often in the active prefixes, but conditioning on them did not help. Rare weak activations on o, e, c, j, z, x. Does not fire at t<3 or on v at positions 0-2.
